what: STAMP RACE UNDOES RE-ARMS: stamp PR #17853 (run 38379540767, merged 2026-10-13T14:34Z) re-stamped RQ-20261009-903 and RQ-20261012-75b2-19 with their pre-re-arm last_dispatched_at, undoing the re-arm landed by #17829 (RQ-REARM-PRODUCER-FAILED) two hours earlier; the dry run read them not_due again. This pass cleared both stamps again, but the cause stands: a stamp PR from a run started before a re-arm overwrites the cleared stamp. The stamp writer must skip a unit whose stamp was cleared after the run began.
